scope scheme(doAuction) {

   // Role hierarchy
   subrole(auctioneer,soc).
   subrole(participant,soc).

   // f* rules implement the role hierarchy transitivity
   // t* rules implement the transitivity of some relations

   // fplay(A,R,G) is true if A play R in G or if A play a subrole of R in G
   fplay(A,R,G) :- play(A,R,G).
   fplay(A,R,G) :- subrole(R1,R) & fplay(A,R1,G).

   // fcompatible(R1,R2,S) is true if R1 or its sub-roles are compatible with R2 in scope S
   fcompatible(R1,R2,S) :- tsubrole(R1,R2).
   fcompatible(R1,R2,S) :- tsubrole(R1,R1a) & tsubrole(R2,R2a) & compatible(R1a,R2a,S).
   fcompatible(R1,R2,S) :- tcompatible(R1,R2,S,[R1,R2]).
   tcompatible(R1,R2,S,Path) :- compatible(R1,R3,S) & not .member(R3,Path) & tcompatible(R3,R2,S,[R3|Path]).
   tsubrole(R,R).
   tsubrole(R1,R2)    :- subrole(R1,R2).
   tsubrole(R1,R2)    :- subrole(R1,R3) & tsubrole(R3,R2).
   // mission_cardinality(mission id, min, max)
   mission_cardinality(mAuctioneer,1,1).
   mission_cardinality(mParticipant,1,2147483647).

   // mission_role(mission id, role id)
   mission_role(mAuctioneer,auctioneer).
   mission_role(mParticipant,participant).

   // mission_goal(mission id, goal id)
   mission_goal(mAuctioneer,start).
   mission_goal(mAuctioneer,decide).
   mission_goal(mParticipant,bid).

   // goal(missions, goal id, dependence (on goal statisfaction), type, #ags to satisfy, ttf)
   goal([mAuctioneer],start,dep(and,[]),performance,all,`1 year`).
   goal([mAuctioneer],decide,dep(and,[bid]),performance,all,`1 hour`).
   goal([mParticipant],bid,dep(and,[start]),performance,all,`10 seconds`).
   goal([],auction,dep(and,[decide]),performance,0,`1 year`).
   super_goal(auction, start).
   super_goal(auction, decide).
   super_goal(auction, bid).

   // ** Rules
   mplayers(M,S,V) :- .count(committed(_,M,S),V).

      (mission_accomplished(S,mAuctioneer) | not mission_accomplished(S,mAuctioneer) & mplayers(mAuctioneer,S,VmAuctioneer) & VmAuctioneer >= 1 & VmAuctioneer <= 1) &

   all_satisfied(_,[]).
   all_satisfied(S,[G|T]) :- satisfied(S,G) & all_satisfied(S,T).
   any_satisfied(S,[G|_]) :- satisfied(S,G).
   any_satisfied(S,[G|T]) :- not satisfied(S,G) & any_satisfied(S,T).

   super_satisfied(S,G) :- super_goal(SG,G) & satisfied(S,SG).

   // ** Norms

   // --- Properties check ---

   // --- commitments ---
   norm n1: 
           scheme_id(S) & responsible(Gr,S) &
           mplayers(mAuctioneer,S,V) & mission_cardinality(mAuctioneer,MMinCard,MMaxCard) & V < MMinCard &
           fplay(A,auctioneer,Gr) &
           not mission_accomplished(S,mAuctioneer) // if all mission's goals are satisfied, the agent is not obliged to commit to the mission

           scheme_id(S) & responsible(Gr,S) &
           mplayers(mParticipant,S,V) & mission_cardinality(mParticipant,MMinCard,MMaxCard) & V < MMinCard &
           fplay(A,participant,Gr) &
           not mission_accomplished(S,mParticipant) // if all mission's goals are satisfied, the agent is not obliged to commit to the mission
        -> obligation(A,not well_formed(S),committed(A,mParticipant,S),`1 year`).
   norm pn2: 
           scheme_id(S) & responsible(Gr,S) &
           mplayers(mParticipant,S,V) & mission_cardinality(mParticipant,MMinCard,MMaxCard) & V < MMaxCard & V >= MMinCard &
           fplay(A,participant,Gr) &
           not mission_accomplished(S,mParticipant) // if all mission's goals are satisfied, the agent is not obliged to commit to the mission
        -> permission(A,responsible(Gr,S),committed(A,mParticipant,S),`1 year`).
